key_insight: ORPG reconciles multiple reward objectives by computing separate clipped policy gradients per reward and combining them with a geometry-aware rule that preserves compatible cooperation while respecting priority under conflict.
engineering_relevance: For multi-objective RL systems, ORPG offers a practical update rule for balancing aligned objectives like helpfulness-safety or correctness-cost without collapsing them into a single scalar reward.
method: Separate clipped policy objective for each reward signal
Reconcile gradients with cosine-dependent interpolation when objectives are compatible
Project conflicting gradients according to task priority
evidence_signal: The paper reports improved average Useful and Harmless scores over the strongest baseline, plus the highest average full-budget accuracy and three-budget hypervolume in mathematical reasoning, with shorter and more accurate outputs than the initial policy.
watch_item: The reconciliation rule depends on correctly identifying compatibility versus conflict and on the chosen priority structure, which may be sensitive to objective scaling and implementation details.
paper_title: ORPG: Reconciling Multiple Reward Objectives through Objective-wise Policy Gradients
